items.text: Checks whether Toshiba drives are detected.
Reads and displays device serial numbers.
Creates a folder for each hard drive under /home/Logs.
Runs the TSBDRV devdump command for each detected drive.
Generates and moves each drive output file into its corresponding serial-number folder.
